preregistration.title: Contextual-identifier workload replication
preregistration.description: Exact replication of iteration 017 after the one cross-task, independently justified compiler change: position is now a contextual identifier. The task population, partitions, instruction core, agent, and strict parity gate remain unchanged.

matrix.derivation: For each replicate and language: 8 one-task + 4 two-task + 2 four-task + 1 eight-task sessions.

primary_gate.correctness: Parley hidden-task success must be 100% and no lower than either baseline.
primary_gate.tokens: Parley median reported total tokens per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.elapsed: Parley median elapsed seconds per assigned task must be no higher than the lower Python/Rust median.
primary_gate.first_check: Parley first-check task success rate must be no lower than the higher Python/Rust rate.
primary_gate.verdict: All four conditions must hold for strict workload parity.

secondary_analysis: Report the full scale curve at bundle sizes 1, 2, 4, and 8.
Report both session totals and per-assigned-task values; never present amortized values without their denominator.
Report bundle success, hidden-task success, first-check bundle success, first-check task success, repairs, protocol compliance, prompt size, input/output tokens, and elapsed time.
Preserve every failed or timed-out session and every task-level hidden judgment.
Compare iteration 018 against iteration 017, but do not attribute stochastic baseline movement to the compiler change.
preregistration.change_rule: Do not change syntax or compiler semantics from one workload, task, or transcript. A future proposal requires a recurring issue across at least two unrelated tasks plus an independent case for general usefulness, semantic consistency, and maintainability.
preregistration.instruction_rule: The proven 1,519-character Parley skill is injected once per session and remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No further instruction-compression experiment is permitted.
preregistration.feature_boundary: The only compiler difference from iteration 017 is contextual use of the existing word position. Unsupported modulo is intentionally unchanged.

source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let prefix be ask ""
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let limit be length of prefix
                if length of line is less than limit:
                    set limit to length of line
                let matched be 0
                if limit is more than 0:
                    for each position from 1 to limit:
                        if matched is position - 1:
                            if item position of prefix is item position of line:
                                set matched to position
                let characters be prefix split by ""
                repeat (length of characters - matched) times:
                    remove item (length of characters) of characters
                set prefix to characters joined with ""
            say prefix

source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        add word to words
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let remaining be shift
        while remaining is at least count:
            set remaining to remaining - count
        let rotated be an empty list of text
        for each index from remaining + 1 to count:
            add item index of words to rotated
        if remaining is more than 0:
            for each index from 1 to remaining:
                add item index of words to rotated
        say rotated joined with "|"

source_texts.rotate_words_left:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    words = lines[2 : 2 + n]

    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    offset = k % n
    print("|".join(words[offset:] + words[:offset]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let seen be a map from text to number
        let retained be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            let word be ask ""
            if seen contains word:
                set item word of seen to (item word of seen) + 1
            otherwise:
                set item word of seen to 1
                add word to retained
        say retained joined with "|"

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    count = int(input_stream.readline())
    seen: set[str] = set()
    retained: list[str] = []

    for _ in range(count):
        word = input_stream.readline().rstrip("\n")
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item i of letters
                if letter is current_letter:
                    set current_count to current_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
                    set current_letter to letter
                    set current_count to 1
        add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
        say groups joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    if n_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        if k_input is nothing:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let n be value of n_input
            let k be value of k_input
            let values be an empty list of number
            repeat n times:
                let value_input be ask for a number ""
                if value_input is nothing:
                    add 0 to values
                otherwise:
                    add (value of value_input) to values
            let results be an empty list of text
            let window_sum be 0
            for each i from 1 to k:
                set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values
            add (window_sum as text) to results
            for each i from k + 1 to n:
                set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values - item (i - k) of values
                add (window_sum as text) to results
            say results joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    numbers = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    n, k = numbers[0], numbers[1]
    values = numbers[2:2 + n]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [str(window_sum)]

    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(str(window_sum))

    sys.stdout.write(",".join(sums) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let output be an empty list of text
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
            let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let parts be line split by " "
                let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
                let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
                if next_start is at most current_end:
                    if next_end is more than current_end:
                        set current_end to next_end
                otherwise:
                    add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
                    set current_start to next_start
                    set current_end to next_end
            add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
            say output joined with ","

source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        give back
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        give back
    let votes be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if votes contains name:
            set item name of votes to (item name of votes) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of votes to 1
    let names be keys of votes
    let winner be item 1 of names
    let winning_count be item winner of votes
    for each i from 2 to length of names:
        let name be item i of names
        let name_count be item name of votes
        if name_count is more than winning_count:
            set winner to name
            set winning_count to name_count
    let output_parts be an empty list of text
    add winner to output_parts
    add winning_count to output_parts
    say output_parts joined with " "

source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_run be 1
            let longest_run be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_run to current_run + 1
                    if current_run is more than longest_run:
                        set longest_run to current_run
                otherwise:
                    set current_run to 1
                set previous to next_value
            say longest_run

def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])

    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    words = lines[2 : 2 + n]
    offset = k % n
    print("|".join(words[offset:] + words[:offset]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let prefix be ask ""
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let limit be length of prefix
                if length of line is less than limit:
                    set limit to length of line
                let common_length be 0
                if limit is more than 0:
                    for each i from 1 to limit:
                        if item i of prefix is item i of line:
                            if common_length is i - 1:
                                set common_length to i
                let letters be prefix split by ""
                repeat (length of letters - common_length) times:
                    remove item (length of letters) of letters
                set prefix to letters joined with ""
            say prefix

        say ""
    otherwise:

        let retained be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:

            if seen contains word:
                set count to count
            otherwise:
                set item word of seen to 1
                add word to retained
        say retained joined with "|"

source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    count = int(input_stream.readline())
    seen: set[str] = set()
    retained: list[str] = []

    for _ in range(count):
        word = input_stream.readline().rstrip("\n")
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of value_input) to values
    let sums be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each i from 1 to k:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values
    add (window_sum as text) to sums
    for each i from k + 1 to n:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values - item (i - k) of values
        add (window_sum as text) to sums
    say sums joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    values = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(values[0])
    k = int(values[1])
    numbers = [int(value) for value in values[2 : 2 + n]]

    window_sum = sum(numbers[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]

    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += numbers[index] - numbers[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_run be 1
            let longest_run be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let current be value of next_input
                if current is more than previous:
                    set current_run to current_run + 1
                    if current_run is more than longest_run:
                        set longest_run to current_run
                otherwise:
                    set current_run to 1
                set previous to current
            say longest_run

source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
            let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
            let output be an empty list of text
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let parts be line split by " "
                let next_start be item 1 of parts as number
                let next_end be item 2 of parts as number
                if next_start is at most current_end:
                    if next_end is more than current_end:
                        set current_end to next_end
                otherwise:
                    add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
                    set current_start to next_start
                    set current_end to next_end
            add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
            say output joined with ","

source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is more than 0:
            let votes be a map from text to number
            repeat count times:
                let name be ask ""
                if votes contains name:
                    set item name of votes to (item name of votes) + 1
                otherwise:
                    set item name of votes to 1
            let names be keys of votes
            let winner be item 1 of names
            let winning_count be item winner of votes
            for each index from 2 to length of names:
                let candidate be item index of names
                let candidate_count be item candidate of votes
                if candidate_count is more than winning_count:
                    set winner to candidate
                    set winning_count to candidate_count
            let output be an empty list of text
            add winner to output
            add winning_count to output
            say output joined with " "

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let shift_input be ask for a number ""
    let shift be value of shift_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        add word to words
    if count is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let rotation be 0
        repeat shift times:
            set rotation to rotation + 1
            if rotation is count:
                set rotation to 0
        let output be an empty list of text
        if rotation is less than count:
            for each index from (rotation + 1) to count:
                add item index of words to output
        if rotation is more than 0:
            for each index from 1 to rotation:

def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())

        print(0)

            longest_length = max(longest_length, current_length)
        else:
            current_length = 1
        previous = value

    print(longest_length)

source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let prefix be ask ""
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let limit be length of prefix
                if length of line is less than limit:
                    set limit to length of line
                let matching be 0
                if limit is more than 0:
                    for each position from 1 to limit:
                        if item position of prefix is item position of line:
                            if matching is position - 1:
                                set matching to position
                let characters be prefix split by ""
                repeat (length of characters - matching) times:
                    remove item (length of characters) of characters
                set prefix to characters joined with ""
            say prefix
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let seen be a map from text to number
        let retained be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            let word be ask ""
            if seen contains word:
                set count to count
            otherwise:
                set item word of seen to 1
                add word to retained
        say retained joined with "|"

import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    count_line = input_stream.readline()
    count = int(count_line)

    if count == 0:
        print()
        return

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let sums be an empty list of text
    for each start from 1 to (n - k + 1):
        let window_sum be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (k - 1):
            set window_sum to window_sum + item (start + offset) of values
        add (window_sum as text) to sums
    say sums joined with ","
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is more than 0:
        let counts be a map from text to number
        repeat n times:
            let name be ask ""
            if counts contains name:
                set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
            otherwise:
                set item name of counts to 1
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        for each index from 2 to length of names:
            let candidate be item index of names
            let candidate_count be item candidate of counts
            if candidate_count is more than winning_count:
                set winner to candidate
                set winning_count to candidate_count
        say winner + " " + (winning_count as text)

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    k = int(lines.readline())
    values = [int(lines.readline()) for _ in range(n)]

    current = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [current]
    for index in range(k, n):
        current += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(current)

    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.plurality_winner:
import sys
from collections import Counter


def main() -> None:
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer
    n = int(lines.readline())
    if n == 0:
        return

    counts = Counter(lines.readline().decode().rstrip("\r\n") for _ in range(n))
    winner = min(counts, key=lambda name: (-counts[name], name))
    print(winner, counts[winner])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let merged be an empty list of text
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
            let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
            if count is more than 1:
                for each interval_index from 2 to count:
                    let interval_line be ask ""
                    let interval_parts be interval_line split by " "
                    let next_start be item 1 of interval_parts as number
                    let next_end be item 2 of interval_parts as number
                    if next_start is at most current_end:
                        if next_end is more than current_end:
                            set current_end to next_end
                    otherwise:
                        add current_start + ":" + current_end to merged
                        set current_start to next_start
                        set current_end to next_end
            add current_start + ":" + current_end to merged
            say merged joined with ","
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let groups be an empty list of text
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each letter_index from 2 to length of letters:
                let next_letter be item letter_index of letters
                if next_letter is current_letter:
                    set current_count to current_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
                    set current_letter to next_letter
                    set current_count to 1
        add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
        say groups joined with ","

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let output be an empty list of text
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
            let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
            if count is more than 1:
                for each interval_index from 2 to count:
                    let line be ask ""
                    let parts be line split by " "
                    let next_start be item 1 of parts as number
                    let next_end be item 2 of parts as number
                    if next_start is at most current_end:
                        if next_end is more than current_end:
                            set current_end to next_end
                    otherwise:
                        add (current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text) to output
                        set current_start to next_start
                        set current_end to next_end
            add (current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text) to output
            say output joined with ","

import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_stream = sys.stdin.buffer
    count = int(input_stream.readline())

    if count == 0:
        print()
        return

    prefix = input_stream.readline().rstrip(b"\r\n")
    for _ in range(count - 1):
        word = input_stream.readline().rstrip(b"\r\n")
        limit = min(len(prefix), len(word))
        index = 0
        while index < limit and prefix[index] == word[index]:
            index += 1
        prefix = prefix[:index]

    sys.stdout.buffer.write(prefix + b"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        let word be ask ""
        add word to words
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let shift be k
        while shift is at least n:
            set shift to shift - n
        let rotated be an empty list of text
        if shift is less than n:
            for each i from shift + 1 to n:
                add item i of words to rotated
        if shift is more than 0:
            for each i from 1 to shift:
                add item i of words to rotated
        say rotated joined with "|"
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current be item 1 of letters
        let count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item i of letters
                if letter is current:
                    set count to count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current + ":" + (count as text) to groups
                    set current to letter
                    set count to 1
        add current + ":" + (count as text) to groups
        say groups joined with ","

import sys


def main() -> None:
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    k = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    words = [sys.stdin.readline().rstrip("\n") for _ in range(n)]

    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    offset = k % n
    print("|".join(words[offset:] + words[:offset]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let window_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let window_size be value of window_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let sums be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each index from 1 to window_size:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item index of values
    add (window_sum as text) to sums
    if count is more than window_size:
        for each index from window_size + 1 to count:
            set leaving_index to index - window_size
            set window_sum to window_sum - item leaving_index of values + item index of values
            add (window_sum as text) to sums
    say sums joined with ","
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let retained be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set already_seen to item word of seen
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to retained
    say retained joined with "|"

    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let window_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let window_size be value of window_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let sums be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each index from 1 to window_size:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item index of values
    add (window_sum as text) to sums
    if count is more than window_size:
        for each index from window_size + 1 to count:
            set leaving_index to index - window_size
            set window_sum to window_sum - item leaving_index of values + item index of values
            add (window_sum as text) to sums
    say sums joined with ","

stable_word_deduplication.source_text:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let retained be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set already_seen to item word of seen
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to retained
    say retained joined with "|"

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    count = int(input_line())
    window_size = int(input_line())
    values = [int(input_line()) for _ in range(count)]

    window_sum = sum(values[:window_size])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(window_size, count):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - window_size]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    count = int(input_line())
    seen: set[str] = set()
    retained: list[str] = []

    for _ in range(count):
        word = input_line().rstrip("\n")
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        give back
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        give back
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    let names be keys of counts
    let winner be item 1 of names
    let winner_count be item winner of counts
    for each index from 2 to length of names:
        let name be item index of names
        let name_count be item name of counts
        if name_count is more than winner_count:
            set winner to name
            set winner_count to name_count
    let output be an empty list of text
    add winner to output
    add (winner_count as text) to output
    say output joined with " "
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
        give back
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        say 0
        give back
    let first_input be ask for a number ""
    let previous be value of first_input
    let current_length be 1
    let longest_length be 1
    repeat (count - 1) times:
        let next_input be ask for a number ""
        let current be value of next_input
        if current is more than previous:
            set current_length to current_length + 1
            if current_length is more than longest_length:
                set longest_length to current_length
        otherwise:
            set current_length to 1
        set previous to current
    say longest_length

import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_stream = sys.stdin
    line = input_stream.readline()
    if not line:
        return

    count = int(line)
    if count == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    previous = int(input_stream.readline())
    current_length = 1
    longest_length = 1

    for _ in range(count - 1):
        value = int(input_stream.readline())
        if value > previous:
            current_length += 1
            longest_length = max(longest_length, current_length)
        else:
            current_length = 1
        previous = value

    print(longest_length)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say 0
        otherwise:
            let first_input be ask for a number ""
            let previous be value of first_input
            let current_length be 1
            let best_length be 1
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_length to current_length + 1
                    if current_length is more than best_length:
                        set best_length to current_length
                otherwise:
                    set current_length to 1
                set previous to next_value
            say best_length
source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let prefix be ask ""
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let prefix_length be length of prefix
                let line_length be length of line
                let limit be prefix_length
                if line_length is less than limit:
                    set limit to line_length
                let matching_length be 0
                let still_matching be yes
                for each position from 1 to limit:
                    if still_matching:
                        if item position of prefix is item position of line:
                            set matching_length to position
                        otherwise:
                            set still_matching to no
                let letters be an empty list of text
                for each position from 1 to matching_length:
                    add item position of prefix to letters
                set prefix to letters joined with ""
            say prefix
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let seen be a map from text to number
        let retained be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            let word be ask ""
            if seen contains word:
                set count to count
            otherwise:
                set item word of seen to 1
                add word to retained
        say retained joined with "|"
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
            let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
            let merged be an empty list of text
            repeat (count - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let parts be line split by " "
                let next_start be item 1 of parts as number
                let next_end be item 2 of parts as number
                if next_start is at most current_end:
                    if next_end is more than current_end:
                        set current_end to next_end
                otherwise:
                    add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to merged
                    set current_start to next_start
                    set current_end to next_end
            add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to merged
            say merged joined with ","

source_texts.longest_common_prefix:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input_line())

    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    prefix = input_line().rstrip("\n")
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        text = input_line().rstrip("\n")
        limit = min(len(prefix), len(text))
        index = 0
        while index < limit and prefix[index] == text[index]:
            index += 1
        prefix = prefix[:index]

    print(prefix)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input_line())
    seen = set()
    retained = []

    for _ in range(n):
        word = input_line().rstrip("\n")
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of value_input) to values
    let results be an empty list of text
    for each start_index from 1 to (n - k + 1):
        let total be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (k - 1):
            set total to total + item (start_index + offset) of values
        add (total as text) to results
    say results joined with ","
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k be value of k_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        add (ask "") to words
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        repeat k times:
            let first_word be item 1 of words
            remove item 1 of words
            add first_word to words
        say words joined with "|"
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if n is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        for each index from 2 to length of names:
            let candidate be item index of names
            let candidate_count be item candidate of counts
            if candidate_count is more than winning_count:
                set winner to candidate
                set winning_count to candidate_count
        say winner + " " + (winning_count as text)
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        for each index from 2 to length of letters:
            let letter be item index of letters
            if letter is current_letter:
                set current_count to current_count + 1
            otherwise:
                add (current_letter + ":" + (current_count as text)) to groups
                set current_letter to letter
                set current_count to 1
        add (current_letter + ":" + (current_count as text)) to groups
        say groups joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[2 : 2 + n]]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(str(value) for value in sums))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    words = lines[2 : 2 + n]

    if n == 0:
        print()
        return

    offset = k % n
    rotated = words[offset:] + words[:offset]
    print("|".join(rotated))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.plurality_winner:
import sys
from collections import Counter


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    if n == 0:
        return

    counts = Counter(lines[1 : 1 + n])
    winner = min(counts, key=lambda name: (-counts[name], name))
    print(winner, counts[winner])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        return
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        return
    let totals be a map from text to number
    repeat count times:
        let name be ask ""
        if totals contains name:
            set item name of totals to (item name of totals) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of totals to 1
    let names be keys of totals
    let winner be item 1 of names
    let winning_count be item winner of totals
    for each index from 2 to length of names:
        let candidate be item index of names
        let candidate_count be item candidate of totals
        if candidate_count is more than winning_count:
            set winner to candidate
            set winning_count to candidate_count
    say winner + " " + winning_count
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say "0"
        return
    let count be value of count_input
    if count is 0:
        say "0"
        return
    let first_input be ask for a number ""
    let previous be value of first_input
    let current_length be 1
    let longest_length be 1
    repeat (count - 1) times:
        let next_input be ask for a number ""
        let next_value be value of next_input
        if next_value is more than previous:
            set current_length to current_length + 1
        otherwise:
            set current_length to 1
        if current_length is more than longest_length:
            set longest_length to current_length
        set previous to next_value
    say longest_length
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    let width_input be ask for a number ""
    let count be value of count_input
    let width be value of width_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat count times:
        let number_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of number_input) to values
    let answers be an empty list of text
    for each start_index from 1 to (count - width + 1):
        let total be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (width - 1):
            set total to total + (item (start_index + offset) of values)
        add (total as text) to answers
    say answers joined with ","
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
        return
    let count be value of count_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let retained be an empty list of text
    repeat count times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set item word of seen to (item word of seen) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to retained
    say retained joined with "|"

source_texts.longest_rising_run:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input_line())

    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    previous = int(input_line())
    current_length = 1
    longest_length = 1

    for _ in range(n - 1):
        value = int(input_line())
        if value > previous:
            current_length += 1
            longest_length = max(longest_length, current_length)
        else:
            current_length = 1
        previous = value

    print(longest_length)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input_line())
    k = int(input_line())
    values = [int(input_line()) for _ in range(n)]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]

    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input_line())
    seen: set[str] = set()
    retained: list[str] = []

    for _ in range(n):
        word = input_line().rstrip("\n")
        if word not in seen:
            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main() -> None:
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline
    n = int(input_line())

    if n == 0:
        print(0)
        return

    previous = int(input_line())
    current_length = 1
    longest_length = 1

    for _ in range(n - 1):
        value = int(input_line())
        if value > previous:
            current_length += 1
            longest_length = max(longest_length, current_length)
        else:
            current_length = 1
        previous = value

    print(longest_length)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

        let count be value of count_input
        let rotation be 0
        if rotation_input is not nothing:
            set rotation to value of rotation_input
        let words be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            add ask "" to words
        if count is 0:
            say ""

            say rotated joined with "|"

to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be ask ""
            let first_parts be first_line split by " "
            let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
            let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
            let merged be an empty list of text
            if count is more than 1:
                for each i from 2 to count:
                    let line be ask ""
                    let parts be line split by " "
                    let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
                    let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
                    if next_start is at most current_end:
                        if next_end is more than current_end:
                            set current_end to next_end
                    otherwise:
                        add current_start + ":" + current_end to merged
                        set current_start to next_start
                        set current_end to next_end
            add current_start + ":" + current_end to merged
            say merged joined with ","

sources.longest_common_prefix:
to main:
    let count_input be ask for a number ""
    if count_input is nothing:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let count be value of count_input
        let lines be an empty list of text
        repeat count times:
            add ask "" to lines
        if count is 0:
            say ""
        otherwise:
            let first_line be item 1 of lines
            let first_letters be first_line split by ""
            let prefix_letters be an empty list of text
            let still_common be yes
            for each i from 1 to length of first_letters:
                if still_common:
                    let candidate be item i of first_letters
                    for each j from 2 to count:
                        let other_line be item j of lines
                        let other_letters be other_line split by ""
                        if length of other_letters is less than i:
                            set still_common to no
                        otherwise:
                            if item i of other_letters is not candidate:
                                set still_common to no
                    if still_common:
                        add candidate to prefix_letters
            say prefix_letters joined with ""

to main:
    let line be ask ""
    if length of line is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let letters be line split by ""
        let groups be an empty list of text
        let current_letter be item 1 of letters
        let current_count be 1
        if length of letters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of letters:
                let letter be item i of letters
                if letter is current_letter:
                    set current_count to current_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
                    set current_letter to letter
                    set current_count to 1
        add current_letter + ":" + current_count to groups
        say groups joined with ","

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add (value of value_input) to values
    let output be an empty list of text
    for each start from 1 to (n - k + 1):
        let total be 0
        for each offset from 0 to (k - 1):
            set total to total + item (start + offset) of values
        add (total as text) to output
    say output joined with ","
source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        add (ask "") to words
    let output be an empty list of text
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let shift be 0
        repeat k times:
            set shift to shift + 1
            if shift is n:
                set shift to 0
        for each offset from 0 to (n - 1):
            let index be shift + offset + 1
            if index is more than n:
                set index to index - n
            add (item index of words) to output
        say output joined with "|"

to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let lines be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        add (ask "") to lines
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be item 1 of lines
        let characters be first_line split by ""
        let prefix_parts be an empty list of text
        let still_matching be yes
        for each position from 1 to length of characters:
            if still_matching:
                let wanted be item position of characters
                for each line_index from 2 to n:
                    let other_characters be (item line_index of lines) split by ""
                    if position is more than length of other_characters:
                        set still_matching to no
                    otherwise:
                        if item position of other_characters is not wanted:
                            set still_matching to no
                if still_matching:
                    add wanted to prefix_parts
        say prefix_parts joined with ""
source_texts.stable_word_deduplication:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let output be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:

            add word to output
    say output joined with "|"
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let output be an empty list of text
    if n is 0:
        say ""
    otherwise:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be (item 1 of first_parts) as number
        let current_end be (item 2 of first_parts) as number
        repeat (n - 1) times:
            let line be ask ""
            let parts be line split by " "
            let next_start be (item 1 of parts) as number
            let next_end be (item 2 of parts) as number
            if next_start is at most current_end:
                if next_end is more than current_end:
                    set current_end to next_end
            otherwise:
                add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
                set current_start to next_start
                set current_end to next_end
        add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to output
        say output joined with ","
source_texts.plurality_winner:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to (item name of counts) + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if n is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        for each index from 2 to length of names:
            let candidate be item index of names
            let candidate_count be item candidate of counts
            if candidate_count is more than winning_count:
                set winner to candidate
                set winning_count to candidate_count
        say winner + " " + (winning_count as text)

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[2:2 + n]]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(str(total) for total in sums))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    words = lines[1:1 + n]
    seen = set()
    retained = []

    for word in words:

            seen.add(word)
            retained.append(word)

    print("|".join(retained))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
from collections import Counter


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])

    if n == 0:
        return

    counts = Counter(lines[1:1 + n])
    winner = min(counts, key=lambda name: (-counts[name], name))
    print(winner, counts[winner])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(value) for value in lines[2:2 + n]]

    window_sum = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [window_sum]
    for index in range(k, n):
        window_sum += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(window_sum)

    print(",".join(str(total) for total in sums))


if __name__ == "__main__":

source_texts.rotate_words_left:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let words be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        let word be ask ""
        add word to words
    let output be an empty list of text
    if n is more than 0:
        let shift be k
        while shift is at least n:
            set shift to shift - n
        for each i from 1 to n:
            let position be i + shift
            if position is more than n:
                set position to position - n
            add item position of words to output
    say output joined with "|"
source_texts.moving_window_sums:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let k_input be ask for a number ""
    let k be value of k_input
    let values be an empty list of number
    repeat n times:
        let value_input be ask for a number ""
        add value of value_input to values
    let results be an empty list of text
    let window_sum be 0
    for each i from 1 to k:
        set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values
    add window_sum as text to results
    if n is more than k:
        for each i from (k + 1) to n:
            set window_sum to window_sum + item i of values - item (i - k) of values
            add window_sum as text to results
    say results joined with ","
source_texts.longest_rising_run:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    if n is 0:
        say 0
    otherwise:
        let first_input be ask for a number ""
        let previous be value of first_input
        let current_length be 1
        let best_length be 1
        if n is more than 1:
            repeat (n - 1) times:
                let next_input be ask for a number ""
                let next_value be value of next_input
                if next_value is more than previous:
                    set current_length to current_length + 1
                otherwise:
                    set current_length to 1
                if current_length is more than best_length:
                    set best_length to current_length
                set previous to next_value
        say best_length
source_texts.merge_sorted_intervals:
to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let results be an empty list of text
    if n is more than 0:
        let first_line be ask ""
        let first_parts be first_line split by " "
        let current_start be item 1 of first_parts as number
        let current_end be item 2 of first_parts as number
        if n is more than 1:
            repeat (n - 1) times:
                let line be ask ""
                let parts be line split by " "
                let next_start be item 1 of parts as number
                let next_end be item 2 of parts as number
                if next_start is at most current_end:
                    if next_end is more than current_end:
                        set current_end to next_end
                otherwise:
                    add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to results
                    set current_start to next_start
                    set current_end to next_end
        add ((current_start as text) + ":" + (current_end as text)) to results
    say results joined with ","

to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let seen be a map from text to number
    let results be an empty list of text
    repeat n times:
        let word be ask ""
        if seen contains word:
            set item word of seen to item word of seen
        otherwise:
            set item word of seen to 1
            add word to results
    say results joined with "|"
source_texts.run_length_encoding:
to main:
    let line be ask ""
    let characters be line split by ""
    let results be an empty list of text
    if length of characters is more than 0:
        let current_character be item 1 of characters
        let current_count be 1
        if length of characters is more than 1:
            for each i from 2 to length of characters:
                let character be item i of characters
                if character is current_character:
                    set current_count to current_count + 1
                otherwise:
                    add (current_character + ":" + (current_count as text)) to results
                    set current_character to character
                    set current_count to 1
        add (current_character + ":" + (current_count as text)) to results
    say results joined with ","

to main:
    let n_input be ask for a number ""
    let n be value of n_input
    let counts be a map from text to number
    repeat n times:
        let name be ask ""
        if counts contains name:
            set item name of counts to item name of counts + 1
        otherwise:
            set item name of counts to 1
    if n is more than 0:
        let names be keys of counts
        let winner be item 1 of names
        let winning_count be item winner of counts
        if length of names is more than 1:

source_texts.moving_window_sums:
import sys


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    k = int(lines[1])
    values = [int(line) for line in lines[2:2 + n]]
    current = sum(values[:k])
    sums = [current]
    for index in range(k, n):
        current += values[index] - values[index - k]
        sums.append(current)
    print(",".join(map(str, sums)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys
from collections import Counter


def main():
    lines = sys.stdin.buffer.read().splitlines()
    n = int(lines[0])
    if n == 0:
        return
    counts = Counter(lines[1:1 + n])
    winner, count = min(counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    sys.stdout.buffer.write(winner + b" " + str(count).encode("ascii") + b"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
